checks.note: Verified the caveat: in redactPhoneLikeSequences, PHONE_PATTERN matches any 8–16 char digit run (e.g. "20230415001") and PHONE_DIGIT_RUN (\d{5,}) then triggers redaction, so sanitize("License 20230415001") returns the marker. The comment's exemption only holds for dash/dot-separated references; compact dates and license/booking numbers with a 5+ digit run are redacted as described.

The trigger exists: handleReviewSubmitted does `body.substring(0, maxInputChars)` with no surrogate back-off. But per the finding's own caveat, confirmation needs (1) the review-body length validation (if body is capped ≤ 2000 chars the branch is unreachable) and (2) GeminiClient.evaluate's serialization of a lone surrogate (mangle vs. throw) — neither is in this file.

The trigger is real in this file: getMessages caps lastReadAt only via findOldestPendingCreatedAtFromOthers (comment confirms PENDING-only intent) while toMessageDto also hides UNDER_REVIEW content. But the consequence depends on code not shown: the JPQL of findOldestPendingCreatedAtFromOthers and countUnreadPerConversation, and AdminMessageService's approval path (the finding's own verification caveat), none of which are available here.
